decisions.reason: As a newly launched certified HVAC heat exchanger, its early website presence suggests acceptable initial prospects and, with results not clearly below aspiration, management would usually retain it while learning accumulates.
The explicit claim of high quality and major market share places this product above aspiration levels relative to peers, so there is little reason for problemistic search or withdrawal.
A dedicated product page indicates strategic attention and likely sufficient expected demand, so boundedly rational management would keep it unless clearer evidence of underperformance emerged.

Because the compact oil cooler was only mentioned rather than strongly highlighted, its standing is more uncertain, but a German machinery firm would usually use available slack to continue one more year before reallocating resources.
Its own page suggests it fits the firm's technical core and has enough promise to remain above a minimum aspiration threshold during the early market-testing phase.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes appear closely related to the firm's established capabilities, and with no sign of a serious shortfall against aspirations, management would be inclined to continue offering them.
